entities.name: Christian Colón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Christian Anthony Colón is a Puerto Rican former professional baseball infielder who currently serves as the hitting coordinator and third base coach for the Kansas City Monarchs of the American Association of Professional Baseball. He played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Kansas City Royals, Miami Marlins, and Cincinnati Reds.
